breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the phrase 'Integrate in time with explicit forward Euler using Strang splitting,' preserving the conflicting instruction. The ground truth resolves this by removing any mention of 'Explicit forward Euler' entirely, since the method uses Strang splitting with exact substeps (exact Fourier-space diffusion and exact logistic ODE solution), none of which involve forward Euler. The generated text fails to remove this contradictory reference.
